$comment: Agent controls, committed to the repo so they apply to everyone who opens it —
not to one person's machine. Copy this to .claude/settings.json and copy the
templates/hooks/ directory to .claude/hooks/, then commit both.
WHY COMMIT IT. A guard that lives in one contributor's local settings protects
one contributor. Everyone else gets nothing, and nobody can tell the difference
by looking at the repo. In the repo, the control is reviewable, versioned, and
SCOPE. This reaches interactive agent seats only. An automated runtime that does
not read these settings needs its own boundary — the two do not substitute for
each other, and assuming they do leaves the gap exactly where it is hardest to see.
